paragraphs: Zevulun ben Dan (identified by Hyman as Shmuel’s student): [Kiddushin 30a](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.30a.3-4).[^1][^2]

notes.text: In the William Davidson digital text of Kiddushin 30a, Shmuel names Zevulun ben Dan as an example in discussing instruction by a grandfather. That scalar does not explicitly call him Shmuel’s student; the parenthetical relationship is Hyman’s.
Rav Yehudah cites Shmuel, who names Zevulun ben Dan as an example of a man taught by his grandfather. Hyman identifies him as Shmuel’s student.
